system.description:
A chemical or biological substance has hooked you, and now you crave it in the blood you drink. You seek out victims whose blood carries your fix, and you vomit up any blood that lacks it.

The substance also has negative aftereffects: alcohol or depressants may leave you with the Negative Trait Lethargic for the rest of the evening after feeding, while amphetamines might inflict Impatient.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
